name: Editor Code Assistant
author: Oliver Marks
description: An ECA (Editor Code Assistant, https://eca.dev) client for the Omarchy shell: runs `eca server` per workspace and chats with it directly — streaming replies, reasoning, tool calls with approval, diffs, chat history, model/agent/variant selection — from the bar or a pop-out window.

barWidget.description: Chat with ECA (Editor Code Assistant) from the bar. Lights up while ECA works or needs your approval.

schema.label: Start the last workspace's ECA server with the shell
Notify on tool approvals, questions and errors
